name: season-strip
title: Season strip
description: Twelve months in a strip that show when something is at its best, with states you read without colour, a legend in words and a note in a tooltip.
docs: months is twelve entries from January to December, each 'best', 'good', 'off' or 'closed', or { state, note } with a note that opens in a tooltip on hover, focus or tap. Each month is a tile with its short name and a state drawn as a fill: solid and bold for the best months, a lighter fill for the good ones, an empty outline out of season and a hatch when closed, with a legend in words, so colour never carries the meaning. A screen reader first hears one sentence ('Best in April, May and September'), then each month with its state. The current month is ringed and marked 'Now' in words once the browser's clock is read, or from now when you pin it. firstMonth (1 to 12) starts the strip somewhere else without reordering the data, locale writes the month names and the sentence, timeZone decides which month it is, and labels carries every word. Twelve tiles in a row where there is room, two rows of six on a phone.
